items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.q: Which schools are beside the Boulevard area?
faq.a: Queensbury Elementary (2020 Moody Avenue) and Ridgeway Elementary (420 East 8th Street) are beside the corridor, and Sutherland Secondary (1860 Sutherland Avenue) is the secondary school west of it; catchments are address-based — confirm the exact address with SD44.

faq.q: How does transit reach downtown Vancouver from Boulevard?
faq.a: Route 240 runs via Grand Boulevard East, 15th Street, Jones Avenue, Keith Road, Marine Drive and the Lions Gate Bridge directly to downtown Vancouver.

faq.q: What do the zoning rules allow on a Boulevard house lot?
faq.a: It depends on the municipality: on the City side the Ground Oriented Zone allows up to 3 units on a lot of 280 m² or less and up to 4 or 6 units on a larger lot depending on the OCP designation; on the District side the R2 zone allows a principal dwelling plus a secondary suite and a coach house.

faq.q: Are there creek or heritage rules to check on Grand Boulevard?
faq.a: Yes. The City Streamside Protection Development Permit Area covers land within 15 metres of a watercourse bank or 10 metres of a ravine bank, Grand Boulevard is a City heritage character area in the Green Necklace system, and District Schedule B creek, slope and wildfire permit areas can apply on the District side.
